body.heading: Count to five
paragraphs: A story needs a who and a what-happened. Try: Lost kite. Kind neighbour helped. Count: Lost(1) kite(2). Kind(3) neighbour(4) helped(5).
That is a whole story in five words. It has a problem and a happy ending.

body.heading: Take turns
paragraphs: Each person makes a five-word story. Others guess what happened in the middle.
Try a funny one, a sleepy one, and one about your favourite animal.

takeaway: Five little words can carry a whole story if you choose them well.
safetyNotes: Count the words on your fingers together to check there are five.
screenFreeExtension: Draw a picture of your five-word story and let your family guess the story from the picture.
